exact_distinctions.boolean_copy: Exact lower-camel booleans copied with nullable presence; false retained, null omitted; supplied target sideload flag overrides read.
exact_distinctions.per_app_list: Source wrapper always assigns empty array; returned raw appSettingsList/other future top-level fields not copied.
